data.gender_notes: Naik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Naik is a Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nayaka', meaning 'hero' or 'leader'. This name is often given to young boys to inspire courage and valor. The name Naik carries the meaning “Young warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naik usually hope their child will grow to embody young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the spirit of a brave warrior, Naik is a name that symbolizes strength and determination.
data.etymology: Naik belongs to the Marathi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naik total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
